description: Create or update a marketplace listing (verified account, marketplace:write). Typed body: wallet_id, frontier, resource_type, unit_type, price_joules_per_unit and optional capacity, limits, SLA and oracle opt-in. A first-time registration carries a one-time fee.

frontier.description: the marketplace frontier the listing is in

idempotency_key.description: your own opaque key: the same key and body is one listing change, never two

max_units_per_match.description: the largest single match, in units

min_units.description: the smallest match you accept, in units

oracle_verified.description: opt IN to oracle verification of your deliveries (a preference, not a badge)

price_joules_per_unit.description: your price in joules per unit, a whole number >= 0

sla.description: your service-level terms, as a JSON object

speed.description: delivery speed class, per the RAREEAI docs

stake_amount.description: joules you stake on the listing

timeout_hours.description: delivery deadline in hours (or use timeout_minutes)

timeout_minutes.description: delivery deadline in minutes (or use timeout_hours)

unit_type.description: the unit the price is per

wallet_id.description: your wallet UUID: it pays the registration fee and receives payouts

body.description: The listing; each field is described in its schema.

name: market_provide
